$comment: Machine-checked by the readiness evaluator (ROLLBACK category). Placeholders <...> are filled from the release manifest rollbackRef. Never contains secret values.

scenarios.trigger: Post-deploy smoke fails, or typecheck/test regression found after merge, on either worker.
scenarios.containment: Freeze promotions in the Hub (no new Uretime Aktar); leave CCOS_HANDOFF_STUB as it was before the release step that failed.
scenarios.rollbackAction: git checkout <rollbackRef.<repo>Commit> in a clean worktree; wrangler deploy --var BUILD_COMMIT:<that sha> (gcos) / wrangler deploy (ccos).
scenarios.verification: Run release/smoke against the rolled-back worker; GET /api/health commit equals the rollback sha.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: None. Worker code is stateless; D1 rows written meanwhile are retained.

scenarios.trigger: Worker fails to start, cron never fires, or bindings (D1, AI, BROWSER) missing after deploy.
scenarios.containment: Stop further deploys; check wrangler tail for the failing worker only.
scenarios.rollbackAction: wrangler rollback <rollbackRef.<repo>VersionId> --name <worker> (Cloudflare version rollback; no rebuild).
scenarios.verification: wrangler deployments list shows the prior version active; smoke passes.

scenarios.trigger: CCOS liveness or handoff intake failing, render/QA regression, or ingest 5xx after deploy.
scenarios.containment: Set GCOS CCOS_HANDOFF_STUB=true (redeploy gcos var) so briefs are ledgered, not sent; approved_briefs stay retryable.
scenarios.verification: GET / on CCOS returns 200; authenticated invalid-payload probe returns 400; re-enable handoff only after smoke passes.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: Low. approved_brief_intake rows are kept; briefs sent during the failure window stay in GCOS handoff_log as retry candidates.

scenarios.trigger: Migration apply errors, or post-apply queries fail (e.g. approved_brief_intake missing/incorrect).
scenarios.containment: Stop deploys and disable the handoff (CCOS_HANDOFF_STUB=true). Do not re-run partially applied migrations blindly.
scenarios.rollbackAction: Additive migrations (040, GCOS numbered) are forward-only: fix forward with a new numbered migration. If data is corrupt, restore with wrangler d1 time-travel restore <db> --timestamp <pre-apply time recorded in the manifest>.
scenarios.verification: wrangler d1 migrations list shows expected level; schema query for the table succeeds; smoke passes.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: Restore discards writes after the restore point; record the pre-apply timestamp BEFORE applying and export needed rows first.

scenarios.trigger: GCOS handoff_log shows repeated failed sends, CCOS returns 401/503/4xx for valid briefs, or brief/ingest counts diverge.
scenarios.containment: Set CCOS_HANDOFF_STUB=true in GCOS; briefs remain in approved_briefs and are not lost.
scenarios.rollbackAction: Fix token/URL/contract mismatch (check secret NAMES with wrangler secret list), then re-send stubbed/failed briefs; ingest is idempotent by briefId so re-sending is safe.
scenarios.verification: Authenticated invalid-payload probe returns 400; one real re-sent brief returns 201/200 and a status callback is logged.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: None. Idempotent by briefId; a payload-hash conflict returns 409 and never overwrites.

scenarios.trigger: Fetch counts drop, cron ticks report partial failures/starvation, or CPU-limit errors after a scheduler deploy.
scenarios.containment: Disable HEKIMLER_CONTINUOUS_INGESTION_ENABLED (var) to stop the heaviest tick; ingestion is optional for core health.
scenarios.rollbackAction: wrangler rollback the GCOS version from rollbackRef; if a cron change caused it, restore the previous crons list from the rollback commit.
scenarios.verification: Next 3 cron ticks complete without scheduled_job_failed; /api/system-health cronLastObserved advances.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: None. Missed ticks are recovered by later polls; no source rows are removed.

scenarios.trigger: Feedback/callback path errors (status callbacks failing, review_feedback writes failing) after release.
scenarios.containment: Feedback is non-blocking: leave production running; callback failures are recorded in approved_brief_intake.callback_last_error.
scenarios.rollbackAction: Disable/roll back only the feedback change (P6 wiring) via the release version rollback; do not roll back the handoff unless it is also broken.
scenarios.verification: Status callback probe succeeds (or is recorded, not lost); core smoke still passes.
scenarios.dataLossRisk: Low. Undelivered status updates are recomputable from CCOS intake status.
